about: [O1b] The jank walk of the new things (brief §5, WAVE_C §7 5): on foot by W (each walk set up facing its target) into every kind the streets now carry - crates, barrels, a barrel, churns, a phone booth, a mailbox, a fruit stand, flowers, a sandwich board, a bicycle, dustbins, a rain barrel, oil drums, a handcart, a newsstand, a street tree, the Hill lane's wall, the cellar bar's railing, the bank's columns, a steps' lamp - each stops the eye short, never inside its box ([O1c] a round thing - barrels, churns, flowers, bins, drums, a mailbox, a tree, a lamp - may stop him or slide him round it, never let him into it: expect 'round'). tools/lib/o1_city.mjs 'walk'. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o1b_jank.json

steps.eval: (G.save.flags.taught = { city_in: true, city_drive: true, city_map: true }, window.__pick = (kind, i = 0, d = 2.8) => { const L = G.stage.part('city').C.dress.filter((q) => q.kind === kind && q.face && !q.alley); const r = L[Math.floor(L.length * 0.37 + i) % L.length]; window.__r = r; return [r.x + r.face[0] * d, r.z + r.face[1] * d]; }, 1)

walks.name: phone booth
walks.from: (() => { const r = G.stage.part('city').C.dress.find((q) => q.kind === 'booth'); window.__r = r; return [r.x + 2.6, r.z]; })()

walks.name: mailbox
walks.from: (() => { const r = G.stage.part('city').C.dress.filter((q) => q.kind === 'mailbox')[3]; window.__r = r; return [r.x, r.z + 2.6]; })()

walks.name: newsstand
walks.from: (() => { const r = G.stage.part('city').C.props.find((q) => q.kind === 'newsstand' && q.o1b); window.__r = r; return [r.x + Math.sin(r.yaw) * 2.6, r.z + Math.cos(r.yaw) * 2.6]; })()

walks.name: street tree
walks.from: (() => { const r = G.stage.part('city').C.trees.find((t) => t.street === 'centre'); window.__r = r; return [r.x, r.z + (r.z > -30 ? 2.4 : -2.4)]; })()

walks.name: the Hill lane's wall
walks.from: (() => { const u = G.stage.part('city').C.uniques.find((q) => q.kind === 'lane'); const p = u.pts[16], a = u.pts[15], b = u.pts[17], L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]), nx = -(b[1] - a[1]) / L, nz = (b[0] - a[0]) / L; window.__r = { x: p[0] + nx * 6, z: p[1] + nz * 6 }; return [p[0], p[1]]; })()

walks.name: the cellar bar's railing
walks.from: (() => { const u = G.stage.part('city').C.uniques.find((q) => q.kind === 'cellar'); const tx = u.nz, tz = -u.nx; window.__r = { x: u.x + tx * 1.2 + u.nx * 0.6, z: u.z + tz * 1.2 + u.nz * 0.6 }; return [u.x + tx * 1.2 + u.nx * 3.6, u.z + tz * 1.2 + u.nz * 3.6]; })()

walks.name: the bank's columns
walks.from: (() => { const u = G.stage.part('city').C.uniques.find((q) => q.kind === 'columns'); const tx = u.nz, tz = -u.nx, w = Math.min(u.len - 2, 14), a = -w / 2 + 0.5 * (w / 6); window.__r = { x: u.x + tx * a + u.nx * 1.1, z: u.z + tz * a + u.nz * 1.1 }; return [window.__r.x + u.nx * 2.8, window.__r.z + u.nz * 2.8]; })()

walks.name: a steps' lamp
walks.from: (() => { const s = G.stage.part('city').C.steps.find((q) => q.kind === 'quay' && q.nz > 0.9); window.__r = { x: s.lamp[0], z: s.lamp[1] }; return [s.lamp[0], s.lamp[1] - 3]; })()

steps.label: the jank walk: every new thing stops a man, never inside it
